about: Every game system the mashup touches, which file implements it, and where its data comes from. GM = addons/silent_katamari/gamemodes/silentkatamari; CV = converter/SilentKatamari.Converter.

realm.about: where it runs (tool = the converter on the player's PC)

from_ouak.about: what it takes from Once Upon A KATAMARI ('-' when nothing)

from_sh2.about: what it takes from SILENT HILL 2 ('-' when nothing)

gmod_api.about: Garry's Mod API it relies on

status.about: planned = designed; built = code written and statically checked; verified = seen working in the real game

rows.summary: Generated from sheets/*.json: every row as a Lua table, plus Rules lookups.
Text lookup in English or Spanish with {name} fill-ins.
Loads what the converter wrote on this PC (status, rules, object list, meshes) and decides per game whether its content is available, with the message to show when not.
Pure Katamari maths with no Garry's Mod calls (unit conversion, catch rule, volume growth, size text, milestones, timer text), so the bench can run it headless.
rows.from_ouak: catch ratio and volume rate (via content)

rows.summary: Applies katamath to entities: longest side, object volume, can-catch, grow.
rows.from_ouak: per-object catch size and volume rate

rows.summary: Registers the converted sounds as sound scripts; roll-up sound by object size; SH2 music, ambience and radio static as looping streams.
rows.from_ouak: roll-up, bump, dash, brake, size-up sounds

rows.summary: The katamari: one physics sphere that resizes as it grows and keeps its collection.
One Katamari object: its converted mesh drawn with IMesh, convex physics from its hull, true size from the object table.
The player is always rolling: spawns hidden and invulnerable, owns one katamari, rides along with it.
Movement keys push the katamari relative to the camera; Shift dashes; walking and weapons are blocked.
Finds objects touching the katamari and decides catch vs bump with the catch rule.
Turns a caught object into part of the katamari (no physics, parented where it touched); hides what is buried.
Builds the stage from the stage and tiers sheets: places Katamari objects by size in rings in the fog, runs the timer, judges the goal, restarts.
rows.from_ouak: which objects exist and their sizes

rows.summary: Builds IMesh objects and materials from converted mesh JSON and PNG textures, with a cache.
rows.from_sh2: James's mesh and textures, ground texture

rows.summary: Draws James Sunderland behind the katamari, skinned on the CPU from a low LOD, playing his own animations chosen from how the katamari moves.
rows.from_sh2: James's skeletal mesh, skeleton, animations, textures

rows.summary: Katamari camera behind and above the ball, pulling back as it grows.
Silent Hill fog over everything, the sky cleared to fog colour, the ground plane, colour grading, and the music / ambience / radio static that rises as time runs out.
rows.from_sh2: ground texture, music, ambience, radio static

rows.summary: Size display, goal, timer, intro and results, drawn with Katamari's own sprites and font when the converter found them.
Keeps Garry's Mod out of sight: every row of the hide sheet.
rows.gmod_api: HUDShouldDraw, ScoreboardShow, PlayerBindPress, PlayerSpray, PlayerSwitchFlashlight, PlayerNoClip, CanPlayerSuicide

rows.summary: Our own pause menu in place of Garry's Mod's: resume, restart, quit.
Loading screen shown instead of Garry's Mod's while the stage loads.
Commands: probe (report what is installed and readable), convert (write the content addon), play (convert when a game changed, then start Garry's Mod hidden behind our gamemode).
Finds Steam (registry, defaults), every library in libraryfolders.vdf, then appmanifest_<id>.acf -> installdir and buildid.
Reads Katamari's Addressables bundles: the object table (sizes, catch sizes, volume rates), object meshes and textures, roll-up sounds, size display sprites and font.
rows.from_ouak: everything listed in extract rows of game ouak

rows.summary: Checks SH2's containers (encryption flag, compression) and, when readable without any key, reads James's mesh, skeleton, animations and textures and the Wwise sounds.
rows.from_sh2: everything listed in extract rows of game sh2

rows.summary: Writes the private content addon (garrysmod/addons/silent_katamari_content): JSON meshes, PNG textures, WAV sounds, status.json last; stages to a temp folder and swaps.
